_about: Hand-written review notes shown next to results. They are NOT output of the analysis run. Each series note names the run it was written for and is only served for that run. Edit or remove a note once the science review has dealt with it.

general.title: GLDAS-2.1 was not built as a consistent climate record
general.note: NASA describes GLDAS-2.0, not the 2.1 product used here, as its temporally consistent series. GLDAS-2.1 is driven by a combination of model and observation-based inputs, so a sudden shift in a series can come from the modelling system as well as from the land surface. Trends in RockIT describe the GLDAS-2.1 estimates. They have not been checked against independent observations.

series.title: Under review: unusually large, step-like rise
series.note: This is the largest trend in the run, more than twice the next region's, and much of the rise arrives in a few sudden jumps rather than a steady climb. The numbers are shown exactly as computed. Until this series is checked against an independent temperature record, read it as a feature of the GLDAS estimates for this region, not as measured warming.
